/* s1_c_iv_neg: label=0 (Contradiction)
   Alice is unmarried, TI=$102,268.
   Claim: pay $27,225 under section 1(c)(iv). Contradiction because
   bracket (iv) requires $115,000 < TI <= $250,000 but TI < $115,000. */

/* Section 1(c)(iv): applies only if $115,000 < TI <= $250,000 */
section_1c_iv_applies(TI) :-
    TI > 115000,
    TI =< 250000.

taxable_income(alice, 102268).
unmarried(alice).

:- ( taxable_income(alice, TI),
     unmarried(alice),
     section_1c_iv_applies(TI)
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.

expected.question: Alice has to pay $27225 in taxes for the year 2017 under section 1(c)(iv).
